Name: Output Volume
Author: Shane Bremseth
Description: Volume and device name for the macOS default output. Works with SoundSource/ARK where the stock volume dial cannot.

Actions.Name: Output Volume
Actions.Tooltip: Shows and adjusts the current output device volume. Press to mute.

TriggerDescription.Push: Toggle mute · hold and turn to switch device
TriggerDescription.Touch: Toggle mute · long press to cycle sample rate
